title: Who said it, in numbers
summary: Each answer shows the persona-clue sentence ("Tohle řekli hlavně důchodci, většinou z Moravy…") and two small stacked bars in shades of the board blue: where the people are from (Praha, Čechy, Morava) and their age band. The name chips sit behind a "Zobrazit všech 29" button.
tradeoffs: Tells the story (who tends to say what) instead of listing names, and is the most analytical; the playful faces and names are one tap further away.
